title: GoCell Assembly Descriptor
description: Defines an Assembly, the physical packaging unit. K#10: minimal required = id+cells+owner; build fields are derived from cell.yaml type when omitted.

id.description: Unique assembly identifier. Must equal the directory name under assemblies/. 2-32 chars (composed-name budget for healthz probe).

cells.description: Cells included in this assembly. Each entry is either a bare cell id string (same-module shorthand) or an object {id, module} where module names the external Go module the cell is developed in (cell development in an independent repository, #1086). module omitted = the assembly's own module.

module.description: Go module path the cell's cellmodules/ package lives in (e.g. github.com/acme/payment-cell). Omit for the assembly's own module. Must be a declared go.mod/go.work dependency; the Go compiler enforces resolvability at build time.

frameworkContracts.description: OPTIONAL per-deployment serving opt-in for framework-owned contracts (ownerCell: _framework). A framework-owned contract has no cell (ADR 202606130635-1939 D4), so the boundary-contract derivation cannot surface it; the assembly that serves such a contract declares its id here. Single source for governance serving-scan (FRAMEWORK-OWNED-CONTRACT-SCOPED-01) and codegen generatedFrameworkServedContracts(). Each entry must be the id of an existing, active, framework-owned http/event contract. Omit for assemblies serving no framework contract.

items.description: Contract id of a framework-owned contract this assembly serves (e.g. http.devicestate.v1).

build.description: Build configuration for the assembly. All fields optional; defaults are derived.

deployTemplate.description: Deployment template identifier. Omit to use the parser-applied default "k8s" (the JSON Schema `default` keyword is documentation only — actual defaulting happens in metadata.applyAssemblyDerivations).

compositionAPI.description: When true, GenerateModulesGen emits the runtime/composition.CellModule form (cellmodules/{cell}.Module() constructors) instead of the legacy local-CellModule-type form. Set true for cellmodules-based assemblies; REQUIRED when any cell declares a non-empty `module` (cross-module cell from an independent Go module, #1086) — the legacy form has no import path and cannot reference a foreign module.

topology.description: OPTIONAL deployment topology for this assembly: the COMPLETE deployment-partition graph. Omit entirely for single-process (all-colocated default — zero-migration path). Declare when cells split across multiple processes; list one group per deployment role and assign every cell to exactly one group (exhaustive, mutually-exclusive partition). Each group is reachable at its endpoint as a remote peer from any other role's perspective. PR-1 (#2278) supports groups authoring, `gocell generate`, and catalog export; per-role process selection at startup (GOCELL_CELL_ROLE → hosting one group's cells in-process) lands in PR-2 — a non-empty GOCELL_CELL_ROLE currently fail-closes. `gocell validate` enforces TOPO-10 (structural), TOPO-11 (provider reachability), TOPO-13 (cross-process broker), TOPO-14 (mTLS endpoint). Validated at governance time by ValidateTopologyStructure.

groups.description: Deployment groups: each is one role hosting a set of cells, reachable by peers at endpoint. The groups must exhaustively and mutually-exclusively partition the assembly's cells[]; roles must be unique.

role.description: Unique deployment role name. Per-role process selection at startup via GOCELL_CELL_ROLE lands in PR-2 (#2278); a non-empty role currently fail-closes.

cells.description: Cell IDs hosted by this group. Must be declared in the assembly's cells[] and must not appear in any other group.

items.description: Cell ID. Must match the canonical CellIDPattern (lowercase letters and digits, starts with letter, 2-32 chars).

endpoint.description: Network address at which this group is reachable as a remote peer (e.g. host:port or https://host/). Must be a syntactically valid host:port or URL with a non-empty host. Validated by ValidateTopologyStructure at governance time.
